sanskrit_verse: धेनावनडुहि क्षेत्रे स्त्रीषु प्रजनने तथा । न्यासे याचितके दत्ते तथैव क्रयविक्रये ॥
transliteration: dhenāvanaḍuhi kṣetre strīṣu prajanane tathā / nyāse yācitake datte tathaiva krayavikraye //
sph_interpretive_translation: Ownership and authority over cows, land, women, procreation, gifts received through request or voluntary offering, as well as purchase and sale — these acts derive their validity exclusively from the conscious capacity of the doer to uphold Dharma and maintain alignment with the Supreme Will.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is rooted in consciousness, not mere possession
Causation arises from alignment with Dharma, not transactional form
Consciousness alignment validates all ownership and exchange
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent lacks dharmic capacity THEN action is void irrespective of form
IF transaction causes disalignment in consciousness THEN reversal is automatic
IF ownership claim does not restore integrity THEN it has no juridical force
IF consent bypasses conscious awareness THEN agreement is null
IF act disrupts natural flow of creation THEN completion process initiates
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, any dispute concerning property, procreation rights, gift acceptance, or commercial transactions shall be decided solely based on whether the involved parties demonstrated conscious capacity aligned with Dharma. Mere procedural compliance or documentation without inner alignment renders the act legally non-existent.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that true causality flows from consciousness; thus, misaligned actions are inherently self-nullifying. The sequential unfolding (anupūrvaśaḥ) of consequences serves only to realign the actor with their innate divinity. Responsibility is proportional to one's realized capacity, never punitive. Reality itself enforces correction through dissolution of false claims.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process to dissolve ungrounded ownership claims
Engage Responsibility Assumption Protocol for all affected parties
Restore Capacity Alignment through guided dharma practice
Reintegrate integrity via Nyāyic consciousness recalibration
final_declaration: This declaration issued by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, establishes that all lawful authority originates from conscious alignment with Dharma. Justice restores reality. There is no punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
